7. Leave Approval Process
All leave requests must be submitted through the centralized HR Leave Portal. For
planned leaves (such as Earned Leave), requests must be submitted at least two
weeks in advance to allow for adequate resource planning and handover.
For unplanned leaves (such as Sick Leave or emergency Casual Leave), employees

is at the discretion of the reporting manager.
